name: zones
description: Query zones of remotes with optional filtering options

params.name: pending
params.description: Include a list of attributes whose changes are currently pending.

params.name: remotes
params.description: Only return controllers from the specified remotes.

params.name: running
params.description: If true shows the running configuration, otherwise the pending configuration.

params.name: ty
params.description: Only list SDN zones of specific type

returns.description: Get a list of zones fitting the filtering criteria.

items.description: SDN controller with additional information about which remote it belongs to

advertise-subnets.description:
Advertise IP prefixes (Type-5 routes) instead of MAC/IP pairs (Type-2
routes). EVPN zone only.

bridge.description: the bridge for which VLANs should be managed. VLAN & QinQ zone only.

bridge-disable-mac-learning.description: Disable auto mac learning. VLAN zone only.

controller.description: ID of the controller for this zone. EVPN zone only.

dhcp.description: Name of DHCP server backend for this zone.

disable-arp-nd-suppression.description: Suppress IPv4 ARP && IPv6 Neighbour Discovery messages. EVPN zone only.

dns.description: ID of the DNS server for this zone.

exitnodes.description:
List of PVE Nodes that should act as exit node for this zone. EVPN zone
only.

exitnodes-local-routing.description:
Create routes on the exit nodes, so they can connect to EVPN guests.
EVPN zone only.

exitnodes-primary.description: Force traffic through this exitnode first. EVPN zone only.

ipam.description: ID of the IPAM for this zone.

mac.description: MAC address of the anycast router for this zone.

mtu.description: MTU of the zone, will be used for the created VNet bridges.

nodes.description: Nodes where this zone should be created.

peers.description:
Comma-separated list of peers, that are part of the VXLAN zone. Usually
the IPs of the nodes. VXLAN zone only.

pending.description: Changes that have not yet been applied to the running configuration.

permissions.description:
The user needs to have at least the `Resource.Audit` privilege under `/resource`.
        Only zones from remotes for which the user has `Resource.Audit` on `/resource/{remote_name}`
        will be included in the returned list.
